in_marathi.name: Chimanbala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of strength and beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chimanbala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chimanbala is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chima' which means 'strength' and 'Bala' which means 'beauty'. This name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of strength, beauty, and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Chimanbala represents the feminine power that nurtures and protects.
